source.note: All FUSS=1 lines wholly inside the supported Zurich polygon. Preserve exact original endpoints and disconnected components; never join 2D intersections or close gaps. Known structures, nearby tagged non-ground walking paths and water are conservative unknown-height masks. Field validation remains pending. Source lines contain no measured walking heights, signal waits, closure status or complete step inventory.

encoding: Exact original LV95 1 micrometre integer deltas, verified coordinate-for-coordinate; not a claim of survey accuracy.
endpointJoin: Only identical original source endpoints. No intersections or proximity joins; disconnected components are retained.
coverage: All complete FUSS=1 features inside the existing Zurich coverage polygon and rectangle. Boundary-crossing features omitted, no invented clipped connections.
